notes_for_editor: NRHP nomination PDF not digitised (22 KB placeholder). NRHP date: NPGallery 7/19/1984 vs Pepper 'August 8. 1988' (Pepper likely means local listing/other event). Wreck date: Tribune dispatch dated 27 Sept 1894 says 'Tuesday night' i.e. 25 September; day computed, not printed. LHB 1892 OCR garbled; temporary tower cost printed as $890 in OCR vs $850 in Pepper/Lighthouse Friends. Whistle hours: Board reports 202 (report in volume labelled 1896-97, fiscal year uncertain) vs Pepper's 573 hours for 1896; story uses only the Board. Efficiency-flag claim rests on the 1918-23 Bulletin index plus a position-matched OCR list on p.275 (heading lost). Fountain as keeper who found Minga is Lighthouse Friends only; Tribune says 'lighthouse keeper'. Ghost stories and Frances Seaman recollections from Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted) paraphrased; ghost stories omitted. Isaac Goudreau laborer 1902 and USCG names from USLHS roster only. Joseph Monosso listed as Jr. by Lighthouse Friends.
